Triple ShootingBasic
Deals 320% ATK DMG to a single enemy and gains a layer of [Boiling].
RoarActive
Increases self 20% ATK for 2 turns while gaining 2 layers of [Boiling] and 1 more action turn.
Werewolf BloodlinePassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2 · Lv.3
Mutu transforms into [Werewolf Form] when [Boiling] reaches 7 layers. Mutu takes 35% less DMG when in [Human Form].
Triple Barrel Lv.1When Mutu is in [Werewolf Form], he also has the DMG Reduction effect of [Human Form]. [Werewolf Form] is retained after he is revived or after wave transitions.
Triple Barrel Lv.2Mutu gains 2 layers of [Boiling] at the beginning of each wave. Resets the cooldown of all skills when he transforms into [Werewolf Form].
Triple Barrel Lv.3Mutu gains 1 layer of [Claws] if he is in [Werewolf Form] at the beginning of the turn. Each layer of [Claws] increases self Piercing Rate by 8%, up to 40%. [Claws] will not be removed when the owner dies or at wave transition.
